messages:
Alex K.: pushed a tiny change to enable the new routing behavior behind a feature flag (new-routing). also added an integration smoke test that exercises the fallback path. PTAL when you have a minute — hoping to get this into tomorrow's canary window.

Morgan: thanks! can you paste the flag name and the env we need to set in staging? want to make sure ops can flip it without a deploy.

Alex K.: sure — flag is `NEW_ROUTING=true`. in k8s we read from configmap `service-flags`. quick snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  NEW_ROUTING: "true"
```
No deploy required, just update configmap and rollout the deployment so pods pick it up.

Sasha: skimmed the test, small nit: the mock timeout is 10s which makes CI slower; can we drop to 2s? also the test asserts on a debug log string — prefer asserting on status code instead.

Alex K.: good catches — lowered timeout to 2s and switched to status assertion. pushed new commit (abc1234 -> def5678).

CI Bot: build passed on def5678 — unit: ✅ integration: flaky (1/3) — re-run queued.

Jamie: I can give this a quick pass later today. is the migration/backwards-compat story covered? i.e., old clients should keep working if flag is off.

Alex K.: yep — default is off, and fallback path untouched. I added a short note in the PR description about compatibility and a tiny e2e that simulates legacy header.

Morgan: heads-up: if we want it in tomorrow's canary, merge cutoff is 16:00 UTC. can someone merge after approvals and then ping infra to reserve the slot?

Sasha: LGTM after Alex's changes. nothing else from me. :thumbsup:

Alex K.: thanks! re-requesting a formal approve — @Jamie @Morgan PTAL when free. i can merge once two approvals are present and infra confirms canary slot.

CI Bot: integration re-run passed on def5678 — all checks ✅.

Jamie: looking now, should be quick. merging if green.

Alex K.: addressed comments, squashed into one commit. merge when ready. thanks everyone.

Morgan: reserved canary slot for 2026-03-21 16:30 UTC with infra. pinged the oncall for verification after merge.

Jamie: approved. merging after final CI. :rocket:

Alex K.: merged, thanks! will watch canary and report back in #incidents if anything spikes.
